threats.description: Apple or the app developer can modify, break, or shut down app functionality and connected services whenever they want, without telling you in advance and without owing you a dime.
No matter how much financial, operational, or personal damage their software failure causes, their max legal payout to you is capped at fifty bucks.
They scrub personal identifiers from your device telemetry and system usage data to fuel the training and optimization of their proprietary algorithms and downstream technologies.
You give up the right to sue them in your local court; you must travel to Santa Clara County, California to fight any legal battle against Apple.

evasionTactics: Incorporation of auxiliary Usage Rules via sub-links
Arbitrary $50 liability cap to render civil litigation non-viable
Broad telemetry harvesting under the guise of product improvement
